name: tracked-state-contract
description: Shared tracked-object/body state schema (Task 2.6, gap-map #19). Generalises ball-state to any tracked object or body. Four consumer classes, one schema: game logic, renderer, telemetry, actuation. Transport-agnostic: OSC bundle (address /tracked/state) or raw UDP JSON — payload fields identical either way.

fields.objects.id: stable per-object id within a session
fields.objects.kind: object class: ball | cue | body | hand | marker | custom:<name>
fields.objects.pos: [x,y,z] metres, right-handed, origin per install calibration
fields.objects.joints: optional pose skeleton: array of {name, pos, conf} for kind=body
fields.events.type: event class: contact | pocket | zone-enter | zone-exit | gesture | custom:<name>

rules: consumers declare consumed fields with `contract-field: <dotted-name>` lines in their product doc; schema-conformance-check verifies membership
additive evolution only within a major version — renames/removals bump the major (expand/contract applied to the wire format)
a divergent field name in any consumer doc fails the conformance check (Law 4)
